product_context.problem_statement: HR teams at mid-size tech companies in Vietnam spend 3-5 hours per day manually reviewing hundreds of resumes, leading to recruiter fatigue, inconsistent shortlisting criteria and delays in filling critical roles.
product_context.value_hypothesis: An AI-assisted resume screening tool can reduce recruiter triage time by 40% and improve shortlist consistency without removing human accountability from any hiring decision.
in_scope: parse and score resumes against job description criteria
surface top-ranked candidates for recruiter review
non_goals: making final hiring or rejection decisions
product_context.user_journey_moment: After job posting closes and before recruiter begins manual shortlist review
product_context.fallback_experience: When AI scoring is unavailable or flagged for review, recruiters revert to the default chronological queue and apply a manual scoring rubric shared by the Talent team.

system_profile.purpose: Parse submitted resumes, score candidates against structured job requirements, and present an ordered shortlist with rationale to recruiters for human review and final decision.
system_profile.decision_impact: The AI score influences which candidates receive early recruiter attention; it does not issue acceptance or rejection. Candidates below threshold still appear in a secondary review queue.
system_profile.deployment_context: SaaS product deployed within the internal HR platform of Vietnamese tech companies; candidates are predominantly based in Vietnam with occasional international applicants.

system_boundary.model: LLM-based resume parser plus rule-based scoring engine against weighted job criteria
system_boundary.application: Recruiter dashboard showing ranked candidate cards with score breakdown and AI rationale

industry_risk_snapshot.rationale: harm_severity=4: A biased or erroneous score can block a qualified candidate from employment, causing significant economic harm and dignity loss. high_stakes=4: Employment decisions affect income, career trajectory and livelihood; errors are hard to detect by candidates. sensitive_data=4: Resumes contain personal data including age proxies (graduation year), gender proxies (name), nationality, and disability disclosures. affected_scale=4: A single deployment can process thousands of candidates per month across many job postings. human_review_need=5: Every rejection path and near-threshold decision must involve a named human reviewer; AI must never issue a terminal rejection. Evidence base: iTutorGroup EEOC settlement (SRC-01) and NIST AI RMF employment guidance (SRC-03).

vietnam.rationale: Vietnam Law 134/2025/QH15 on AI (effective 2026-03-01) and Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg high-risk AI list must be reviewed by legal counsel to confirm whether automated resume scoring for employment qualifies as high-risk AI and what specific obligations apply before pilot launch.

eu.rationale: EU AI Act Annex III explicitly lists AI systems used in employment, worker management and access to self-employment as high-risk. The product must comply with data governance, human oversight, transparency and accuracy requirements applicable to high-risk AI systems, subject to current staged implementation timeline.

legal_classification.other_markets: Southeast Asia expansion (e.g. Singapore, Thailand) would require separate counsel review of local employment and data-protection law before market entry.

product_metrics.success_kpi: Median recruiter triage time from application deadline to first qualified candidate review reaches 1 business day or less within 60 days of pilot launch.
product_metrics.risk_kri: Shortlist recall gap between any two monitored demographic groups (gender proxy, age bracket) remains at or below 5 percentage points per monthly evaluation cycle.
product_metrics.guardrail_metric: Count of AI-issued terminal rejections (i.e. candidate removed from all queues without recruiter action) remains exactly zero in every reporting period.
product_metrics.review_cadence: Monthly performance and bias evaluation; immediate ad-hoc review triggered by any recruiter override rate exceeding 25%, any discrimination complaint, or any change to model, scoring criteria, or target market.

release_blockers: GAP-01: Vietnam legal classification memo not yet signed off by legal counsel
GAP-02: Candidate transparency notice and appeal mechanism not yet designed or tested
GAP-03: Pre-launch disparate-impact bias evaluation not yet completed and independently reviewed
GAP-04: EU AI Act conformity assessment and role analysis not yet completed for EU market entry
release_conditions: zero automatic terminal-rejection paths confirmed by QA
bias evaluation report with subgroup recall gap below 5 pp reviewed by independent reviewer
named on-call escalation owner designated for pilot period
release_decision.next_review_trigger: Review on any disparity threshold breach, discrimination complaint, recruiter override rate above 25%, model or criteria change, new market entry, or 2026-11-30 whichever comes first.
release_decision.residual_risk_rationale: Pilot is scoped to recommendation-only with no automatic rejection path. Recruiter review is mandatory for all candidates. Monthly bias monitoring with predefined stop thresholds limits residual discriminatory-impact risk. Appeal mechanism is available for any candidate who receives a human rejection decision.
